protocol:
Fingerprinting aquatic virus communities using pulsed field gel electrophoresis (PFGE)
Prepare the 1.5% agarose and the lysis buffer.
Incubate the agarose at 80°C until further use.
Dispense 5 mL of the freshly made lysis buffer into 50-mL Falcon tubes, one for each sample.
Combine equal volumes (200 µL) of virus concentrate and molten 1.5% agarose.
Mix briefly.
Dispense the mixture into plug molds with a pipette.
Place the plug molds in the freezer (–20°C) for at least 2 min to set.
Remove the tape from the bottom of the plug molds and push the plugs out from the molds into 5 mL lysis buffer.
Incubate the plugs in lysis buffer overnight in the dark at 30°C.
The next day, decant the lysis buffer using a plastic sieve (screened cap) that can be attached at the top of the Falcon tube.
Wash the plugs three times, 30 min each, in TE buffer 10:1 at room temperature.
The plugs can be stored at 4°C in TE 20:50 for several month before further processing; nevertheless, we recommend running the samples as soon as possible, because degradation of the viral DNA will occur and result in less discrete bands.
Set up the gel rig.
Prepare a 1% agarose gel in 1× TBE buffer.
Melt until the agarose is completely dissolved.
Place the warm agarose at 60°C for 10 min before pouring into the gel rig and allowing it to cool.
Keep ~5 mL agarose at 60°C for later use to seal the wells.
When the agarose is set, pour 50 mL of 1× TBE running buffer on the top of the gel and place it in the refrigerator for at least 20 min or overnight.
Place molecular weight standards (slices of ~5 mm) on either side of the gel.
Place the samples between the markers using a sterile loop.
Overlay the wells with leftover molten 1% agarose.
Remove the gel from the pouring rig and remove any extraneous agarose from the bottom and edges.
Prepare the 1× TBE (running buffer) and place at 14°C until further use.
Place the gel into the electrophoresis chamber and carefully pour the cooled 1× TBE running buffer into the chamber.
Run the gel at 6 V cm–1 with pulse ramps from 20 to 40 s (for example) at 14°C for 22 h. 
To separate different viral genome size classes, each sample could be run three times:

parameters.speed: 6 V cm–1 with pulse ramps from 20 to 40 s

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: prepare (reagent: 1.5% agarose, other: {'buffer': 'lysis buffer'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(reagent='agarose', temperature='80°C', duration='until further use')
dispense(container='50-mL Falcon tubes', reagent='freshly made lysis buffer', volume='5 mL', one for each sample=True)
combine(reagent='virus concentrate and molten 1.5% agarose', volume='200 µL each', equal volumes=True)
mix(reagent='virus concentrate and agarose mixture', duration='briefly')
dispense(container='plug molds', reagent='mixture', using pipette=True)
place(container='plug molds', temperature='-20°C', duration='at least 2 min', location='freezer')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: remove (container: plug molds, other: {'item': 'tape from bottom'})
# MANUAL: push (container: plug molds, reagent: plugs, other: {'destination': 'into 5 mL lysis buffer'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(reagent='plugs in lysis buffer', temperature='30°C', duration='overnight', condition='in the dark')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: decant (container: Falcon tube, reagent: lysis buffer, other: {'using': 'plastic sieve (screened cap)'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
wash(reagent='plugs', temperature='room temperature', duration='3 times, 30 min each', buffer='TE buffer 10:1')
store(reagent='plugs', temperature='4°C', duration='several months', buffer='TE 20:50')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: set up (container: gel rig, other: {})
# MANUAL: prepare (reagent: 1% agarose gel in 1× TBE buffer, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
melt(reagent='agarose', duration='until completely dissolved')
place(reagent='warm agarose', temperature='60°C', duration='10 min')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: pour (container: gel rig, reagent: warm agarose, other: {'allow to cool': True})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
keep(reagent='agarose', volume='~5 mL', temperature='60°C', duration='for later use', purpose='seal wells')
pour(container='top of gel', reagent='1× TBE running buffer', volume='50 mL')
place(container='gel', temperature='refrigerator', duration='at least 20 min or overnight')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: place (container: gel, reagent: molecular weight standards (slices of ~5 mm), other: {'location': 'either side of gel'})
# MANUAL: place (container: gel, reagent: samples, other: {'location': 'between markers', 'tool': 'sterile loop'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
overlay(container='wells', reagent='leftover molten 1% agarose')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: remove (container: gel, other: {'from': 'pouring rig', 'extraneous agarose': 'bottom and edges'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
prepare(reagent='1× TBE (running buffer)', temperature='14°C', duration='until further use')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: place (container: gel, other: {'location': 'electrophoresis chamber'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
pour(container='electrophoresis chamber', reagent='cooled 1× TBE running buffer')
run(container='electrophoresis chamber', reagent='gel', temperature='14°C', duration='22 h', speed='6 V cm–1 with pulse ramps from 20 to 40 s')
